text:
After a bright day, it was good to get your complaint, and we are sorry that your journey with Aurelia Skyways left you upset and worried about your companion animal. You said that the cabin was uncomfortably warm, that the attention given by the crew did not meet expectation, and that the handling of your pet during transit felt careless and distressing.

We have reviewed the report from the flight team and the notes from the welcome team, and we agree that the standard of care you received should have been better. The cabin animal monitor is there to keep a close watch on pets throughout the flight, and the team should have acted sooner when the conditions began to slip. We are sorry that this did not happen with the care and steadiness you deserved.

<<FACT F117>>

That guidance is meant to give travelers a fair route to raise concerns when heat in the cabin affects an animal, and your report has been treated as a serious service issue. We are also checking why the communication around the incident was so thin, since clear updates are part of the support we expect from the Companion Animal Travel Desk. We understand that a pet's comfort is not a small matter, and the trust you place in us depends on calm handling and honest follow-through.

<<FACT F114>>

In light of what you reported, we have logged the service failings for quality review and have asked the flight and ground teams to revisit the steps they took before, during, and after boarding. While that review continues, please accept our apology for the stress this caused you and your animal. We know that a smooth trip means more than simply reaching the destination, and we are sorry that Aurelia Skyways did not deliver that standard on this occasion.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
